visual.general_description: Nine grayscale prostate MRI sub-images in three lettered rows (A, B, C), each with coronal T2, axial T2 and ADC-map views.
visual.detailed_description: Three rows of three grayscale MRI sub-images, rows lettered A, B, C at upper left of each row. Each row shows a coronal T2 image on the left, an axial T2 image in the middle and a parametric map on the right. Rows A and B show a large black oval structure at the posterior part of the axial images, consistent in position with an endorectal coil mentioned in the caption; row C lacks it and shows a smaller heterogeneous prostate region with a noisier map. No numbers, arrows or identifying text are visible in the pixels.

panels.general_description: Row of three prostate MRI sub-images: coronal T2, axial T2 and ADC map.
panels.detailed_description: Row A: left, a coronal T2 image of the pelvis with a bright structure at the upper right and a dark midline structure over the pelvic floor; middle, an axial T2 image of the prostate region with a large black oval structure at the posterior (lower) part, consistent in position with an endorectal coil, and a small round structure near the center; right, a grayscale map in which a bright crescent surrounds a black central region at the lower center. The letter (A) is printed at upper left of the row. No numeric values are printed in the image.
